text: Heels close to your hips, feet flat.

review.notes: Selkowitz supports bridging as a glute exercise; foot distance is convention. Question: source for the cue itself?

text: Push the floor away through your heels.

review.notes: Convention. Question: any EMG source for heel versus toe push in a bridge?

text: Ribs down, squeeze your glutes at the top.

review.notes: Kept from the K1 example. Contreras studied the loaded hip thrust; the rib cue is convention.

text: Push hips back, knees only slightly bent.

review.notes: Hinge pattern defines the RDL in McAllister; wording is ours.

text: Keep the dumbbells brushing your legs.

review.notes: Convention. Question: source for keeping the load close to the body?

text: Stop lowering when your back would round.

review.notes: McAllister reports erector spinae activity, but the stop rule is convention. Question: want a spine-loading source.

text: Squeeze glutes, stand tall, don't lean back.

review.notes: Convention.

text: Rise as high as you can, then pause.

review.notes: Lunsford and Perry use full-height heel rise as the measure of calf function.

text: Lower slowly, counting two seconds.

review.notes: Tempo comes from the catalogue cue. Silbernagel shows heel-rise loading in Achilles care but not this tempo. Question: tempo source.

text: Press through the big toe, ankles straight.

review.notes: Convention. Question: source for ankle alignment.

text: Band just above the knees, feet hip-width apart.

review.notes: Cambridge studied walks, not lifts; the knee band position was the easiest there.

text: Press knees out against the band.

review.notes: Selkowitz: bridging gluteal activity above tensor fascia lata. Knees-out push is convention.

text: Hold the top, ribs down.

review.notes: Convention.

text: Keep both hip bones level, like a tray.

review.notes: Selkowitz: unilateral bridge had a high glute-to-TFL index. Level-pelvis cue is convention.

text: Drive through your planted heel.

review.notes: Convention.

text: Lifted leg stays in line with your body.

review.notes: Catalogue cue reworded.

text: Back flat on the wall, feet forward.

review.notes: Convention. Escamilla is about dynamic squats, used by analogy.

text: Knees over ankles, thighs near parallel.

review.notes: Convention, from the catalogue cue.

text: Sit only as low as feels comfortable.

review.notes: Escamilla: knee-joint forces rise with more bend in squats. Applied by analogy, grade C.

text: Breathe steadily, don't hold your breath.

review.notes: MacDougall measured heavy lifts; applying it to a wall sit is an extrapolation.

text: Lie on your side, knees bent, feet together.

review.notes: Setup is convention.

text: Open the top knee, heels stay touching.

review.notes: Selkowitz had the clam top of its glute-to-TFL index.

text: Keep your pelvis still, don't roll back.

review.notes: Convention. Distefano found clam activation modest (about 34-40% of max effort), so it is a low-load drill.

text: Stay slightly squatted, knees soft.

review.notes: Berry: squat posture raised gluteal and lowered tensor fascia lata activity in resisted side-stepping.

text: Take small steps, keep the band tight.

review.notes: Convention.

text: Toes point forward, not out.

review.notes: Convention. Cambridge found a band at the feet shifts work toward the glutes; toe direction itself is unsourced.

text: Push your knees gently out into the band.

review.notes: Convention.

text: Feet about shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

review.notes: Catalogue says shoulder width; toe angle is convention.

text: Knees follow the line of your toes.

review.notes: From the catalogue. Powers links hip control and knee mechanics.

text: Chest up, sit down between your hips.

review.notes: Catalogue cue reworded.

text: Keep your whole foot on the floor.

review.notes: Check the full text of Schoenfeld before review.

text: Back to a wall, heels about 30 cm out.

review.notes: No technique source found. Catalogue cue reworded.

text: Lift your toes toward your shins, heels down.

review.notes: Convention only. Question: source wanted.

text: Lower slowly, don't let your toes slap down.

review.notes: Convention only.
